(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.sodium-svg').dataset;if(d.sodiumCorrection!==window.sodiumBase.sodiumCorrection||d.sodiumDatum===window.sodiumBase.sodiumDatum)throw Error('Na sensitivity');return 'Na raises datum, correction unchanged';})()

(()=>{const d=document.querySelector('.sodium-svg').dataset;if(Number(d.sodiumRise)!==0||Number(d.sodiumTravel)!==0)throw Error('zero correction');return '100 mg/dl gives zero travel and zero rise';})()

(()=>{const selects=[...document.querySelectorAll('select[aria-label="Einheit für Glukose"]')];if(selects.some(e=>e.value!=='1')||Math.abs(Number(document.querySelector('#anatomy-glucose').value.replace(',','.'))-400/18.0182)>1e-7)throw Error('unit sync');return 'mg/dl to mmol/l preserves true result and geometry';})()
(()=>{if(Math.abs(Number(document.querySelector('#field-glucose').value.replace(',','.'))-20.1)>1e-7)throw Error('SI keyboard step');return 'Keyboard step uses selected unit 0.1 mmol/l';})()
(()=>{if(Number(document.querySelector('#field-glucose').value.replace(',','.'))<=20.1)throw Error('pointer glucose');return 'Glucose pointer changes shared selected-unit input';})()
(()=>{if(Number(document.querySelector('#field-sodium').value.replace(',','.'))<=130)throw Error('pointer Na');return 'Sodium pointer changes shared input';})()

(()=>{if(document.querySelector('.result-number').textContent!=='—'||[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-sodium-variable]')].some(e=>e.style.display!=='none'))throw Error('invalid stale');return 'Invalid converted glucose hides every variable solid and result';})()

(()=>{const handle=document.querySelector('[data-sodium-target]'),svg=document.querySelector('.sodium-svg');const start=new TouchEvent('touchstart',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,touches:[new Touch({identifier:1,target:handle,clientX:10,clientY:10})]});handle.dispatchEvent(start);const move=new TouchEvent('touchmove',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,touches:[new Touch({identifier:1,target:handle,clientX:10,clientY:20})]});handle.dispatchEvent(move);handle.dispatchEvent(new TouchEvent('touchcancel',{bubbles:true,touches:[]}));const free=new TouchEvent('touchstart',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,touches:[new Touch({identifier:2,target:svg,clientX:20,clientY:20})]});svg.dispatchEvent(free);const freeMove=new TouchEvent('touchmove',{bubbles:true,cancelable:true,touches:[new Touch({identifier:2,target:svg,clientX:20,clientY:30})]});svg.dispatchEvent(freeMove);svg.dispatchEvent(new TouchEvent('touchend',{bubbles:true,touches:[]}));if(!start.defaultPrevented||!move.defaultPrevented||free.defaultPrevented||freeMove.defaultPrevented)throw Error('touch lock');return 'Native TouchEvent: handle start/move cancelled, cancellation releases, non-controls scroll';})()

(()=>{if(document.documentElement.scrollWidth>innerWidth)throw Error('overflow');const rs=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-sodium-target]')].map(e=>e.getBoundingClientRect());if(rs.some(r=>r.width<43.9||r.height<43.9))throw Error('small target');const [a,b]=rs;if(a.left<b.right&&a.right>b.left&&a.top<b.bottom&&a.bottom>b.top)throw Error('overlap');return 'Two separate 44px targets; no horizontal overflow';})()
(()=>{if(document.querySelector('.sodium-svg').dataset.sodiumFrame!==window.sodiumOffFrame)throw Error('offscreen loop');return 'Offscreen input pauses geometry RAF';})()
